title: Rename HalfEdgeMeshEngine to HalfEdgeMeshOps: it edits geometry, and 'Engine' reads like the render runtimes
description: User ruling 2026-10-18, an exception to the no-renames rule: HalfEdgeMeshEngine (geometry/mesh/data/representation) is static topology editing on HalfEdgeMesh (build, add/remove, split/flip/collapse/replaceFaces, subdivide, normals), but its name gets confused with the render runtimes (HalfEdgeMeshRuntime, MeshOverlayRuntime). Rename it HalfEdgeMeshOps, same package, every caller updated, no behaviour change. Done after MESH-60, which deletes ArrayMeshEngine and moves compileSurfaceData into HalfEdgeMeshRuntime, so the rename only touches what survives. Javadoc and ARCHITECTURE.md references follow; Ixdar/CLAUDE.md is the user's to update (report it if it names the class).
definition-of-done:
1. HalfEdgeMeshEngine is HalfEdgeMeshOps; no source, test or doc names the old class.
2. Build, full suite and quad-suite signatures unchanged.
testing-plan: 1. mvn test; quad-suite signature sweep against MESH-60's after run.
